@TheINAOG
Hey, they just dropped something creamy in Pinokio! (Pinokio 7 landed March 17, 2026 — all about AI agents)
Ever heard of Pinokio? It's the ultimate "browser for local AI" right now → http://pinokio.co
One-click installs for ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion, LLMs, music/voice gens, agents… all local, zero venv hell, no dependency drama.
But the real killer feature in Pinokio 7? The Agent Interpreter — zero-config magic that lets any AI agent (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor…) auto-discover, launch, and control ANY app in Pinokio. No setup. Agents just talk to your localhost and handle everything.
Pinokio: The 1-Click Localhost Cloud
